title: GPU/AI-host (ComfyUI) cryptojacking run from sanctioned Aeza
summary: An operator on the OFAC-sanctioned bulletproof host Aeza (AS210644) mass-scans internet-exposed AI image-generation (ComfyUI) and other GPU hosts and deploys cryptominers. The staging host is still live and VirusTotal-flagged as of 2026-09-10 (ports 8080/8081 up), holding large scan-result sets, 10+ miner builds, and directories masquerading as system/kubelet components for persistence.
detail: A cryptojacking operation on the OFAC-sanctioned bulletproof host Aeza (AS210644) targeting internet-exposed AI/GPU hosts, notably ComfyUI image-generation servers. The staging host 176[.]124[.]207[.]93 remains Shodan-visible and VirusTotal-flagged (4) as of 2026-09-10 on ports 8080/8081. It holds scan-result corpora tying back to mass ComfyUI scanning, 10+ distinct miner builds (xmrig and alternatives), and masquerade directories imitating system and kubelet helper components for persistence. GPU-host cryptojacking is a rising monetisation pattern; sanctioned-BPH hosting gives it takedown resistance. Assessed high-confidence on first-party evidence plus current VT flagging.
